models.name: weighing-indicator-model

properties.name: weight
properties.desc: 实时重量（32位有符号，低字在前）

models.yaml:
apiVersion: devices.kubeedge.io/v1beta1
kind: DeviceModel
metadata:
  name: "weighing-indicator-model"
  namespace: "default"
spec:
  properties:
  - name: "weight"
    description: "实时重量（32位有符号，低字在前）"
    type: INT
    accessMode: ReadOnly
    unit: "kg"

devices.name: chengzhong

properties.name: weight
properties.desc: 实时重量（32位有符号，低字在前）

devices.yaml:
apiVersion: devices.kubeedge.io/v1beta1
kind: Device
metadata:
  name: "chengzhong"
  namespace: "default"
  labels:
    description: ""
spec:
  deviceModelRef:
    name: "weighing-indicator-model"
  nodeName: "nt001"
  properties:
  - name: "weight"
    collectCycle: 1000
  protocol:
    protocolName: nengtan-iot
    configData:
        com:
          commType: serial
          serialPort: "/dev/ttyUSB-weigh"
          baudRate: 9600
          dataBits: 8
          parity: "none"
          stopBits: 1
        slaveID: 1
        visitors:
        - propertyName: "weight"
          register: HoldingRegister
          offset: 0
          limit: 2
          scale: 0.01
          isSwap: false
          isRegisterSwap: true
